title: Grateful Dead Live at Pauley Ballroom, U. of California on 1970-06-21
lineage: unknown transfer to WAV-1648 marked 2nd-Gen > Wavelab (small edits & speed adjust) > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1648 tagged.
source: AUD said to have been recorded by Harry Ely

ai_review.summary: Echoey audience tape with mixed performance; standout NFA→St Stephen segue but overall poor sound quality.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience capture in a cavernous hall, resulting in echo‑filled and muddy audio that many listeners find hard to sit through. Musically the show offers a novel Not Fade Away → St Stephen transition that some fans enjoy, yet the first song is deemed unremarkable and the tape ends abruptly.

ai_rating.rationale: One reviewer rates it 0/5 due to terrible recording quality, while another gives 4/5 for a unique song segue; the mixed feedback and only two reviews lead to a moderate confidence rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Echo‑filled, cavernous hall sound with little clarity; no soundboard source, many listeners describe it as skippable and abrasive.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unusual segue flips the typical Not Fade Away → St Stephen order, creating a long jam early in NFA; the show ends abruptly and overall pacing is described as uneven.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His moaning on 'Candyman' is noted positively, though no other specific comments.
